lines.say: Exhibit A. Nine tabs of the same worked example.
Exhibit B. A problem sheet, blank, saved as final.
Exhibit C. A highlighter. Out of ink.
The verdict? Guilty. Of reading, not doing.
The sentence: explain it from a blank page.
Offload plans those sessions, then tests you from a blank page.
It brings each topic back before you forget it.
You just click the link in your calendar.
